summary: Third test pass focused on new on-chain launch detection feature (onchain_watcher, price_feed, pool_info.js sidecar). All 41 pytest tests pass. /api/health and /api/metrics return expected JSON shape. Backend has been running stably ~7 min post-hot-reload with periodic scan cycles hitting real Solana mainnet RPC and no tracebacks/crash loops. Node.js pool_info.js sidecar returns real mainnet DBC pool data (success:true with all numeric fields incl. price_sol_per_token, supply_tokens, market_cap_sol, quote_reserve_sol, is_migrated) for the known mainnet pool BPQQsb... No raw secrets (Telegram token, Anoncoin key, Solscan key, wallet private key) found in supervisor logs. Non-blocking: uvicorn --reload picked up onchain_watcher.py changes and restarted a few times before settling; production deployment should not run with --reload.
